title: Message/get rejects ids=null violating RFC 8620 5.1
description: Message/get requires ids to be a non-null array, returning invalidArguments for ids=null or ids absent. RFC 8620 section 5.1 specifies ids=null means return all objects. Every other get handler (Chat/get, Contact/get) correctly accepts ids=null. A standard JMAP client doing Message/get with ids=null gets an error instead of the full list. Fix: accept ids=null/absent and return all messages, matching RFC 8620 and the other get handlers.
